title: Vanishing soundness error
statement: For every noise level $r>0$, define $E_r(\varepsilon)=\sqrt{\varepsilon}/2$ when $\varepsilon\le r$ and $E_r(\varepsilon)=1/2$ otherwise. Then $E_r(\varepsilon)\to 0$ as $\varepsilon\to0$ through positive values.
